headline: Congress goes dark with pro forma sessions as recess continues through the week.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened in pro forma session on Monday, August 17 for just 38 seconds, meeting briefly at 1:30 p.m. before adjourning until Thursday morning. This minimal session maintains Congress's technical presence during the August recess.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly at 9 a.m. on Monday, August 17 and adjourned just 8 minutes later after Speaker Pro Tempore Goldman presided. Nine bills and one resolution were introduced during the quick session, with no votes or substantive business conducted.
